text.autoconfig.spatialhud.title: Spatial HUD
text.autoconfig.spatialhud.option.enable: Turns Spatial HUD on or off. The separate Toggle Spatial HUD Controls binding changes this same setting.
text.autoconfig.spatialhud.option.showPa: Draw a subtle translucent backing behind the selected HUD content. Method 2 and Method 3 capture this backing into the same texture as the icons and text.
text.autoconfig.spatialhud.option.onlyDu: Keep Spatial HUD out of inventories, chat, pause screens, Mod Menu, and every other open screen. Texture methods always enforce this boundary.
text.autoconfig.spatialhud.option.render: Choose how the selected lower HUD is drawn. Method 1 is the original stable path. Methods 2 and 3 capture only the selected lower HUD to a private texture; they never capture screens, chat, maps, debug text, or unrelated mod GUIs.
text.autoconfig.spatialhud.option.distan: How far in front of the player the panel sits, in block units. This is shared by all three methods.
text.autoconfig.spatialhud.option.planeW: Physical width of the panel in block-like units. Increase this for a larger hotbar and surrounding HUD strip.
text.autoconfig.spatialhud.option.virtua: Move the panel left or right relative to its horizontal anchor. Positive values move it right.
Move the panel above or below eye height. The default places it around waist height.
The downward look angle where the physical panel appears rectangular. 30 degrees is the default. Looking above or below this angle produces real perspective in Method 2 and Method 3.
Additional fixed physical tilt. Leave this at 0 unless you intentionally want to move the face-on angle.
Turn the panel left or right within its horizontal anchor. Small values are usually enough.
text.autoconfig.spatialhud.option.worldS: Method 3 only. Camera Yaw keeps the plane in front while you look around. Player Body keeps it aligned to body direction and may leave it to the side when looking away.
Method 3 only. When enabled, blocks between the camera and panel can hide it like a physical object. Disable to draw the world-space plane through blocks.
text.autoconfig.spatialhud.option.preser: Keep Companion Bars Native in Method 1

For the Classic Affine method only, keep AppleSkin and Detail Armor Bar Reconstructed status roots in their native layout to avoid detached injected pixels. Texture methods capture the whole selected root instead.
text.autoconfig.spatialhud.option.showHo: Include the hotbar, spectator menu, and spectator tooltip.
text.autoconfig.spatialhud.option.showXp: Include the experience progress bar and level number.
text.autoconfig.spatialhud.option.showMo: Include mount health while riding an entity.
text.autoconfig.spatialhud.option.showHe: Include the selected item name above the panel.
